name: Niger
title: LGBT rights in Niger
extract: Lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer, intersex and asexual (LGBTQIA) people in Niger face severe challenges not experienced by non-LGBTQIA residents. Same-sex sexual activity was explicitly outlawed in 2025 and penalized in 2026, and the Nigerien LGBTQIA community faces stigmatization among the broader population.
